edits.new:
The maximum page size, the sort key and the exact JSON types of the row answer are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0486; ASM-0678); this story fixes the field names and the column order and leaves the field-level detail to the baseline review.

Released rows are read by contract, not by file. `GET /case-list/dates/{businessDate}` answers the `publishStatus` and the `rowCount` of the business date; `GET /case-list/rows` answers the paged rows in the 19-column order; `snapshot(page)` serves the in-namespace caller. `rwb-case` reads the rows for SCR-02 and `rwb-reporting` reads them for its measures. The publish status gate of RWB-P1-E1011-APP is kept as the release point. The PUBLISHED check answers YES when a date is RELEASED; the answer for other statuses is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0485).
